welcome.metaTitle: LMS — courses, tests and chat with your teacher
welcome.title: Courses, tests and talking to your teacher — all in one place
welcome.lead: Learn on any device, track your progress and ask your teacher questions in the course chat. Teachers build courses from lessons and tests without any technical skills.
welcome.previewTest: Test after each section · timer and instant results

choose.title: Choose a course
choose.text: Find a course in the catalogue by topic, price or level and look through its syllabus.

enroll.title: Enrol or buy
enroll.text: Free courses open once the teacher approves you; paid courses open right after payment.

learn.title: Learn and take tests
learn.text: Work through lessons at your own pace, pass the tests and get a certificate.

students.title: For students
students.item1: a personal dashboard with your progress and a “Continue” block;
students.item2: videos, notes and a test after every section;
students.item3: chat with the teacher and the course group.

teachers.title: For teachers
teachers.item1: a course builder: sections, lessons, tests;
teachers.item2: student requests and their progress in one table;
teachers.item3: your own course price and a public landing page.

dark.title: Dark theme
dark.text: Light, dark or follow the system.

mobile.title: Mobile-friendly
mobile.text: The interface adapts to your phone.

free.a: Yes. Some courses are free — just send a request and the teacher will approve it.

attempts.q: How many times can I take a test?
attempts.a: There’s no limit on attempts; the latest one counts.

teacher.q: How do I become a teacher?
teacher.a: Choose the “Teacher” role when signing up — the course builder opens once you confirm your email.

mobile.q: Does the platform work on a phone?
mobile.a: Yes, every page is adapted for mobile devices.

welcome.finalText: Create an account in a minute — confirm your email and start learning.

privacy.title: Privacy and cookies
privacy.intro: This page explains what data the platform collects and why. We don’t sell data and don’t use advertising cookies.
privacy.accountText: Your email, first and last name are needed to sign in, for confirmation emails and certificates. Learning progress, test results and chat messages are stored so you can continue learning on any device.
privacy.emailsText: We send emails to confirm your address, to recover your password and — unless you turn it off in your profile — notifications about requests, new lessons and test results.
privacy.analyticsText: Only with your consent do we enable Google Analytics 4 to see which pages and features are used. IP addresses are anonymised; emails and names are never sent to analytics. You can opt out at any time — clear the site data in your browser and the banner will appear again.
privacy.cookiesText: Session cookies are needed to sign in. Your theme, language and analytics consent choices are kept in the browser’s local storage or in cookies.

consent.text: We use Google Analytics to understand how to improve the platform. There are no advertising cookies.
